title: Exact and epic augmentation of the sheafified free presheaf Čech nerve
statement: Let C,J and abelian sheafification be as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let f:E→P be a locally surjective arrow of v-valued presheaves of sets. For the alternating-face complex A_n=(Z[N_n(f)])# [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex], let ε:A_0→(Z[P])# be induced by the base map of the zeroth wide pullback. Then d_1≫ε=0, the short complex A_1→A_0→(Z[P])# is exact, and ε is epic. This only asserts augmented degree-zero exactness, with no syzygy objects or positive-degree claims.

source.place: Tag 01GC, Lemma 25.4.2 and its proof; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GC.

proof.text: Both faces of an edge have the same base map. Expand the first alternating-face differential as the difference of the two faces and use functoriality to prove augmentation_zero.

For a set map factor through its range. Choose a section only of the resulting surjection, whose existence is proved by Function.Surjective.hasRightInverse. Mathlib Arrow.AugmentedCechNerve.extraDegeneracy supplies an extra degeneracy and its map under the free abelian functor. Its degree-zero identity s_0 d_1 = id - epsilon s_prime gives every element of the kernel as d_1(s_0 x). The nerve is unchanged by postcomposition with the range inclusion: construct inverse wide-pullback lifts and verify their naturality. Transfer exactness through this nerve isomorphism and the monomorphism obtained by free abelianizing the range inclusion, using ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono.

Construct nerveMapIso for every finite-limit-preserving functor using preservesLimitIso and HasLimit.isoOfNatIso. Verify the projection and base formulas. Apply this to evaluation of set presheaves. After free abelianization, evaluation commutes with the first differential because it preserves finite sums and integer scalar multiplication. Construct a short-complex map with isomorphic first two components and identity third component. Objectwise exactness and jointly faithful evaluation, via JointlyReflectsIsomorphisms.exact_iff, give exactness of the presheaf augmentation for any presheaf map.

Sheafification is exact by its finite-limit preservation and left adjoint structure. Map the exact presheaf short complex through presheafToSheaf and identify its differential with the sheafified alternating differential using map_sum and map_zsmul.

Prove locally_surjective_hom_ext: maps from the target of a locally surjective set-presheaf map to a sheaf agree when their precompositions agree, by separatedness on the covering image sieve. Compose the whiskered free-forgetful adjunction with the sheafification adjunction. Its natural hom equivalence reduces cancellation for the sheafified free map to locally_surjective_hom_ext; the underlying set presheaf of an abelian sheaf is a sheaf by coyonedaObjIsoForget. Finally the degree-zero wide-pullback projection has an explicit section, hence is locally surjective, so its composite with the original locally surjective map (the base augmentation) is locally surjective. The cancellation result supplies Epi epsilon.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01GC, degree-zero image-factorization and exact-sheafification argument; K1 uses Mathlib extra degeneracy for the contraction and an adjunction cancellation proof of epimorphy.
